#            boot (apt base tools, python3, uv, Node 22 + npm, Docker Engine).
#            Missing required tool after install attempt => FAIL, not WARN.
#   ISSUE 3: SSH hardening drop-in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-k3-hardening.conf
#            is recreated every boot; sshd -t gated; single ssh restart after
#            host-key restore + hardening; effective config verified (sshd -T).
#   ISSUE 4: user k3 is waited for (<=60s), created if still absent, added to
#            docker group; chown of /data/k3 itself failing is FATAL.
#   ISSUE 5: All v2 safety invariants preserved:
#            - NEVER auto-format the data disk
#            - NEVER touch the boot disk
#            - /data mounted by UUID; existing filesystem UUID unchanged
#            - NO SECRETS in this script or instance metadata
# Guarantees:
#   1. Waits for the 300GB stateful data disk (device: persistent-disk-1).
#   2. NEVER formats a disk that already has a filesystem. NEVER touches the
#      boot disk. If the data disk has no filesystem, it FAILS EXPLICITLY
#      (manual mkfs decision only -- see Section 9 of the execution guide).
#   3. Mounts /data via UUID, repairs /etc/fstab idempotently.
#   4. Recreates the /data/k3 directory tree (mkdir -p, never destructive).
#   5. Plan A: restores persisted SSH host keys from /data/k3/system/ssh-host-keys
#      so the host fingerprint survives MIG recreation.
#   6. Recreates SSH hardening drop-in and verifies effective sshd config.
#   7. Installs/verifies ALL required G1 runtime (fails if any required tool
#      is missing after install attempt).
#   8. Writes a machine-readable status file and a full log.
#      Log:    /var/log/k3-bootstrap.log
#      Status: /data/k3/system/last_bootstrap.json  (+ /var/run/k3-bootstrap.ok)
# ============================================================================
set -Eeuo pipefail

LOG=/var/log/k3-bootstrap.log
exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

TS() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }
STATUS="unknown"
FAIL_REASON=""

log() { echo "[$(TS)] $*"; }

write_status() {
  local mounted="false"
  if mountpoint -q /data 2>/dev/null; then mounted="true"; fi
  if [ "$mounted" = "true" ]; then
    mkdir -p /data/k3/system || true
    cat > /data/k3/system/last_bootstrap.json <<EOF || true
{"ts":"$(TS)","hostname":"$(hostname)","status":"${STATUS}","reason":"${FAIL_REASON}","data_mounted":${mounted},"boot_id":"$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"}
EOF
  fi
  if [ "$STATUS" = "OK" ]; then
    touch /var/run/k3-bootstrap.ok || true
  else
    rm -f /var/run/k3-bootstrap.ok || true
  fi
}

die() {
  trap - ERR
  STATUS="FAIL"
  FAIL_REASON="$*"
  log "FATAL: $*"
  write_status
  exit 1
}

# ISSUE 1: ERR trap -- any unguarded command failure aborts with FAIL status.
on_err() {
  local rc=$1 line=$2 cmd=$3
  trap - ERR
  STATUS="FAIL"
  FAIL_REASON="ERR trap: command '${cmd}' failed (rc=${rc}) at line ${line}"
  log "FATAL: ${FAIL_REASON}"
  write_status
  exit 1
}
trap 'on_err $? $LINENO "$BASH_COMMAND"' ERR

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PATCH B: bounded retry helper with exponential backoff for network-dependent
# operations. Finite attempts; retries exhausted => die() (strict FAIL).
# The ERR trap is temporarily disabled during each attempt so a transient
# failure reaches the retry logic instead of aborting via on_err; the trap is
# restored before returning / before die().
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
retry() {
  local max_attempts=$1 delay=$2; shift 2
  local attempt=1 rc=0
  while [ "$attempt" -le "$max_attempts" ]; do
    log "retry ${attempt}/${max_attempts}: attempting: $*"
    trap - ERR
    set +e
    "$@"
    rc=$?
    set -e
    trap 'on_err $? $LINENO "$BASH_COMMAND"' ERR
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
      log "retry ${attempt}/${max_attempts} succeeded: $*"
      return 0
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -lt "$max_attempts" ]; then
      log "retry ${attempt}/${max_attempts} for '$*' after failure (rc=${rc}); sleeping ${delay}s before next attempt"
      sleep "$delay"
    else
      log "retry ${attempt}/${max_attempts} for '$*' failed (rc=${rc}); retries exhausted"
    fi
    attempt=$((attempt+1))
    delay=$((delay * 2))  # exponential backoff
  done
  die "retries exhausted (${max_attempts} attempts) for: $*"
}

log "===== k3-p4 bootstrap start (template v4) ====="

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 1: Wait for the stateful data disk (up to 180 s)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DISK="/dev/disk/by-id/google-persistent-disk-1"
WAITED=0
until [ -e "$DISK" ]; do
  [ "$WAITED" -ge 180 ] && die "data disk $DISK not present after 180s"
  sleep 5; WAITED=$((WAITED+5))
  log "waiting for $DISK (${WAITED}s)"
done
REAL_DEV="$(readlink -f "$DISK")"
log "data disk present: $DISK -> $REAL_DEV"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 2: Safety -- confirm this is NOT the boot disk and is ~300GB (ISSUE 5)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
BOOT_DEV="$(findmnt -no SOURCE / | sed -E 's/p?[0-9]+$//')"
case "$REAL_DEV" in
  "$BOOT_DEV"*) die "safety abort: $DISK resolves to boot device $BOOT_DEV" ;;
esac
SIZE_GB=$(( $(blockdev --getsize64 "$REAL_DEV") / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 ))
if [ "$SIZE_GB" -lt 290 ] || [ "$SIZE_GB" -gt 310 ]; then
  die "safety abort: $DISK size ${SIZE_GB}GB is not ~300GB"
fi
log "safety checks passed: non-boot, ${SIZE_GB}GB"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3: Filesystem check -- NEVER reformat. Fail explicitly if blank. (ISSUE 5)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
FSTYPE="$(blkid -s TYPE -o value "$REAL_DEV" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$FSTYPE" ]; then
  die "data disk has NO filesystem. Refusing to auto-format. Run Section 9 (manual, gated mkfs) once."
fi
if [ "$FSTYPE" != "ext4" ]; then
  die "data disk has unexpected filesystem '$FSTYPE' (expected ext4). Manual inspection required."
fi
UUID="$(blkid -s UUID -o value "$REAL_DEV")"
log "filesystem ok: ext4 UUID=$UUID"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 4: Idempotent fstab repair + mount /data (by UUID)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p /data
FSTAB_LINE="UUID=$UUID /data ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2"
HAS_DATA_LINE=0; HAS_UUID_LINE=0
if grep -qE '^[^#]*\s/data\s' /etc/fstab; then HAS_DATA_LINE=1; fi
if grep -qF "UUID=$UUID /data" /etc/fstab; then HAS_UUID_LINE=1; fi
if [ "$HAS_DATA_LINE" -eq 1 ] && [ "$HAS_UUID_LINE" -eq 0 ]; then
  cp -a /etc/fstab "/etc/fstab.bak.$(date -u +%s)"
  sed -i -E '\#^[^\#]*\s/data\s#d' /etc/fstab
  log "removed stale /data fstab entries (backup kept)"
  HAS_UUID_LINE=0
fi
if ! grep -qF "UUID=$UUID /data" /etc/fstab; then
  echo "$FSTAB_LINE" >> /etc/fstab
  log "fstab entry added"
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
if ! mountpoint -q /data; then
  mount /data || die "mount /data failed"
fi
log "/data mounted: $(findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /data)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5a: Recreate K3 directory tree (never destructive)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p /data/k3/{repo,state,external-repos,runs,experiments,checkpoints,artifacts,backups,infra,system}
mkdir -p /data/k3/data/{raw,normalized,parquet,microstructure}
for f in p4_progress.jsonl cost_ledger.jsonl preemptions.jsonl; do
  [ -f "/data/k3/state/$f" ] || touch "/data/k3/state/$f"
done
log "directory tree ensured"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5b: ISSUE 4 -- ensure user k3 exists (wait <=60s, then create), then
# apply TARGETED, NON-RECURSIVE ownership (PATCH A).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
K3_WAIT=0
while ! id k3 >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  if [ "$K3_WAIT" -ge 60 ]; then
    log "user k3 absent after ${K3_WAIT}s; creating via useradd"
    useradd -m -s /bin/bash k3 || die "useradd k3 failed"
    break
  fi
  log "waiting for user k3 (${K3_WAIT}s elapsed; guest agent may create it)"
  sleep 5; K3_WAIT=$((K3_WAIT+5))
done
id k3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "user k3 still does not exist after wait/create"

# PATCH A: targeted, NON-RECURSIVE ownership. No chown -R anywhere.
# 1) /data/k3 itself: failure here is fatal (but never recursive).
chown k3:k3 /data/k3 || die "chown k3:k3 /data/k3 failed"
# 2) Bootstrap-created top-level directories only (Step 5a mkdir -p set).
#    Non-recursive: existing ownership below repo/artifact/data trees is
#    preserved (large Parquet/L2 data lake must NOT be traversed).
K3_OWNED_DIRS=(
  /data/k3/repo /data/k3/state /data/k3/external-repos /data/k3/runs
  /data/k3/experiments /data/k3/checkpoints /data/k3/artifacts
  /data/k3/backups /data/k3/infra /data/k3/system
  /data/k3/data /data/k3/data/raw /data/k3/data/normalized
  /data/k3/data/parquet /data/k3/data/microstructure
)
for d in "${K3_OWNED_DIRS[@]}"; do
  [ -d "$d" ] && chown k3:k3 "$d" || true
done
# 3) Bootstrap-created state files (only if they exist).
for f in /data/k3/state/p4_progress.jsonl /data/k3/state/cost_ledger.jsonl /data/k3/state/preemptions.jsonl; do
  [ -f "$f" ] && chown k3:k3 "$f" || true
done
log "user k3 present; targeted non-recursive ownership applied to /data/k3 tree tops"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6: Plan A -- restore persisted SSH host keys (restart deferred to 6b)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HK_DIR=/data/k3/system/ssh-host-keys
SSH_NEEDS_RESTART=0
HK_FOUND=0
if [ -d "$HK_DIR" ]; then
  if ls "$HK_DIR"/ssh_host_*_key >/dev/null 2>&1; then HK_FOUND=1; fi
fi
if [ "$HK_FOUND" -eq 1 ]; then
  for k in "$HK_DIR"/ssh_host_*; do
    b="$(basename "$k")"
    if ! cmp -s "$k" "/etc/ssh/$b"; then
      install -m 600 -o root -g root "$k" "/etc/ssh/$b"
      case "$b" in *.pub) chmod 644 "/etc/ssh/$b";; esac
      SSH_NEEDS_RESTART=1
    fi
  done
  if [ "$SSH_NEEDS_RESTART" -eq 1 ]; then
    log "SSH host keys restored from $HK_DIR (ssh restart deferred to hardening step)"
  else
    log "SSH host keys already match persisted copies"
  fi
else
  log "NOTE: no persisted host keys at $HK_DIR (Plan A seed step not done yet, or Plan B in use)"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6b: ISSUE 3 -- recreate SSH hardening drop-in, validate, restart, verify
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HARDEN=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-k3-hardening.conf
HARDEN_CONTENT='PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
PubkeyAuthentication yes'
mkdir -p /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
if [ ! -f "$HARDEN" ] || [ "$(cat "$HARDEN")" != "$HARDEN_CONTENT" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$HARDEN_CONTENT" > "$HARDEN"
  chmod 644 "$HARDEN"
  SSH_NEEDS_RESTART=1
  log "SSH hardening drop-in (re)written: $HARDEN"
else
  log "SSH hardening drop-in already correct: $HARDEN"
fi
sshd -t || die "sshd -t failed: sshd config invalid; refusing to restart ssh"
if [ "$SSH_NEEDS_RESTART" -eq 1 ]; then
  systemctl restart ssh || die "ssh restart failed after host-key restore / hardening"
  log "ssh restarted (host keys + hardening applied in one restart)"
else
  systemctl reload ssh || systemctl restart ssh || die "ssh reload/restart failed"
  log "ssh reloaded (no changes needed, config re-asserted)"
fi
# Verify EFFECTIVE config
SSHD_EFF="$(sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '^(permitrootlogin|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|pubkeyauthentication) ' || true)"
for want in "permitrootlogin no" "passwordauthentication no" "kbdinteractiveauthentication no" "pubkeyauthentication yes"; do
  if ! printf '%s\n' "$SSHD_EFF" | grep -qix "$want"; then
    die "sshd effective config check failed: wanted '$want'; got: $(echo "$SSHD_EFF" | tr '\n' '; ')"
  fi
done
log "sshd effective config verified: rootlogin=no, passwordauth=no, kbdinteractive=no, pubkey=yes"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 7: ISSUE 2 -- idempotently install + VERIFY all required G1 runtime
# (network-dependent operations wrapped in retry -- PATCH B)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
APT_PKGS=(git curl wget ca-certificates jq rsync make gcc g++ build-essential pkg-config sqlite3 tmux zstd unzip)

APT_UPDATED=0
apt_update_once() {
  if [ "$APT_UPDATED" -eq 0 ]; then
    retry 3 5 apt-get update -y
    APT_UPDATED=1
  fi
}

# PATCH B helper wrappers for curl|sh pipelines (so retry can re-run them)
uv_install_k3() {
  su - k3 -c 'curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh'
}
nodesource_setup_22() {
  curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash -
}
docker_script_download() {
  curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o /tmp/get-docker.sh
}

# 7.1 base apt packages -- install only what's missing
MISSING_PKGS=()
for p in "${APT_PKGS[@]}"; do
  if ! dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MISSING_PKGS+=("$p"); fi
done
if [ "${#MISSING_PKGS[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
  log "installing missing apt packages: ${MISSING_PKGS[*]}"
  apt_update_once
  retry 3 5 apt-get install -y "${MISSING_PKGS[@]}"

UV_BIN=""
if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  UV_BIN="$(command -v uv)"
elif [ -x /home/k3/.local/bin/uv ]; then
  UV_BIN=/home/k3/.local/bin/uv
fi
if [ -z "$UV_BIN" ]; then
  log "uv missing; installing via astral.sh for user k3"
  retry 3 5 uv_install_k3
  [ -x /home/k3/.local/bin/uv ] || die "uv still missing at /home/k3/.local/bin/uv after install"
  UV_BIN=/home/k3/.local/bin/uv
fi

# 7.4 Node.js 22 + npm (NodeSource)
NODE_OK=0
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then

  case "$NODE_V" in v22.*) NODE_OK=1 ;; esac

  retry 3 5 apt-get install -y nodejs
  case "$(node --version 2>/dev/null || true)" in v22.*) : ;; *) die "node is not v22.x after install" ;; esac

  usermod -aG docker k3 || die "usermod -aG docker k3 failed"
  log "added k3 to docker group"

if ! systemctl is-active --quiet docker; then
  systemctl start docker || die "docker installed but failed to start"

# 7.6 VERIFY every required tool; any miss => FAIL
declare -A TOOLCHECK=(
  [git]="git --version"

)
RUNTIME_MISSING=""
for t in "${!TOOLCHECK[@]}"; do
  if command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
